race.comment: MIGHTY JUDD (3) did little and finished 8 lengths from the winner in eighth over 1200m at Toowoomba last start after being prominent at the corner, a less impressive effort than his first-up fourth at Gatton the run before. Well placed and there is no reason why he cannot find winning ways. SOUTHAMPTON NICCO (4) hit the frame two starts ago at Inverell but ran below par last time when eighth and beaten 5.5 lengths over 1000m at Casino. Likely improver with top-three prospects. EGYPITIAN'S REWARD (8) was much better last time out at Hatton when sitting on the speed. The inside draw is a big tick and he can be in this for a very long way. RESOLUTE LADY (10) is third-up now on the back of a strong performance last start. Trending the right way and can feature in the finish again.
